discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing (sequencing by synthesis with reversible fluorescent terminators and cluster amplification)
rationale: This is fundamentally chemistry: reversible terminator nucleotide chemistry and surface cluster amplification. It changed genomics, medicine and biology by cutting sequencing costs by orders of magnitude. The three have already won the Millennium Technology Prize and the Breakthrough Prize together. After the 2025 materials prize (MOFs), a turn toward chemistry at the biology interface fits the committee's usual rotation.
